name: Map Script
description: Writes war3map.j (or war3map.lua for Lua maps) from the map's data like the World Editor does on save: triggers, variables, regions, cameras, sounds, placed units and destructables, item tables, player and force setup. Runs when one of those files is saved, or on command.

services.description: Script languages written in trigger texts that compile to JASS (vJASS, Zinc, cJass, Wurst …): register.

mcpTools.name: build_script
mcpTools.description: Rebuilds the map script from triggers and objects now, and checks it: the errors, each with its line, the code there and the trigger it's from. Always use after writing or changing a script. This checks grammar and types, not what the game will do.

mcpTools.name: search_script_api
mcpTools.description: Looks up the game's script functions, types and constants, with their exact signatures, so nothing has to be guessed. Names are the same in JASS and Lua.

filter.description: Part of a name, not case sensitive, like Hashtable or SpecialEffect.

script.generateOnSave.description: Rewrite the map script (war3map.j, or war3map.lua for Lua maps) whenever triggers, regions, cameras, sounds, placed objects or map info are saved.
